Section 1. [+PAY FOR PERFORMANCE. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; modifying appropriations from the workforce development fund.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PAY FOR PERFORMANCE.

Of the amounts appropriated in law from the workforce development fund for grants to pass-through entities, 25 percent in fiscal year 2026 and 50 percent in fiscal year 2027 are for performance grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.8747.
additions: Of the amounts appropriated in law from the workforce development fund for grants to pass-through entities, 25 percent in fiscal year 2026 and 50 percent in fiscal year 2027 are for performance grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.8747.
